mapper.select: SELECT act03_journal_dtl_id AS journal_dtl_id, act03_dr_account_cd AS dr_account_code, f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_dr_account_cd) AS dr_account_name, act03_dr_amt AS dr_amt, f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_dr_ast_id) AS dr_ast_name, act03_cr_account_cd AS cr_account_code, f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_cr_account_cd) AS cr_account_name, act03_cr_amt AS cr_amt, f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_cr_ast_id) AS cr_ast_name FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act03_journal_dtl ON act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_date = #{payDate} AND act02_pay_month_cd = #{payType} ORDER BY act03_seq

SELECT f_cdnm('trCode', f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id), act02_company_id, act02_date) AS tr_name, f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS corp_name, f_get_journal_note(act02_journal_id) AS note, CASE WHEN COALESCE(drAst.ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') = 'KRW' THEN act03_dr_amt ELSE act03_dr_for_amt END AS dr_for_amt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(crAst.ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') = 'KRW' THEN act03_cr_amt ELSE act03_cr_for_amt END AS cr_for_amt FROM act03_journal_dtl INNER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_journal_id = act03_journal_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree drAst ON drAst.ast01_class_tree_id = act03_dr_ast_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree crAst ON crAst.ast01_class_tree_id = act03_cr_ast_id WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_date = #{date} AND ( (#{drCrType} = 'D' AND act03_dr_ast_id = #{astId}) OR (#{drCrType} = 'C' AND act03_cr_ast_id = #{astId}) ) ORDER BY act02_journal_no, act03_seq

SELECT act03_journal_dtl_id AS journal_dtl_id , f_cdnm('trCode', f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id), act02_company_id, act02_date) AS tr_name , act03_dr_account_cd AS dr_account_code , f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_dr_account_cd) ||CASE WHEN act03_dr_ast_id is null THEN '' ELSE '('||f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_dr_ast_id)||')' END AS dr_ast_account_name , act03_dr_amt AS dr_amt , act03_dr_for_amt AS dr_for_amt , act03_dr_note AS dr_note , act03_cr_account_cd AS cr_account_code , f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_cr_account_cd) ||CASE WHEN act03_cr_ast_id is null THEN '' ELSE '('||f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_cr_ast_id)||')' END AS cr_ast_account_name , act03_cr_amt AS cr_amt , act03_cr_for_amt AS cr_for_amt , act03_cr_note AS cr_note FROM act02_journal LEFT OUTER JOIN ast06_tr ON ast06_tr_id = act02_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast07_settle ON ast07_settle_id = act02_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN biz01_promo ON biz01_promo_id = act02_biz_id , act03_journal_dtl WHERE act02_journal_id = act03_journal_id AND act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_journal_id = #{journalId} ORDER BY act03_seq

SELECT x.act03_journal_dtl_id AS journal_dtl_id, x.act02_date AS date, x.act02_journal_no AS journal_no, CAST(CAST(x.act02_journal_no AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) AS journal_no_str, x.act02_journal_id AS journal_id, x.act02_tr_cd AS tr_code, x.act02_tr_nm AS tr_name, x.act02_corp_nm AS corp_name, x.act02_note AS note, x.act03_account_cd AS account_code, x.act03_account_nm AS account_name, x.act03_dr_amt AS dr_amt, x.act03_cr_amt AS cr_amt, x.act03_dr_ast_nm AS dr_ast_name, x.act03_dr_note AS dr_note, x.act03_bal_amt AS bal_amt FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY act02_date, act02_journal_no, seq) AS act03_journal_dtl_id , act02_date , act02_journal_no , act02_journal_id , act02_tr_cd , act02_tr_nm , act02_corp_nm , act02_note , act03_account_cd , act03_account_nm , act03_dr_amt , act03_cr_amt , act03_dr_ast_nm , act03_dr_note , SUM(act03_bal_amt) OVER (ORDER BY act02_date, act02_journal_no, seq, dtl_seq) AS act03_bal_amt FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE downAccountTree ( act01_account_cd , act01_parent_cd , depth , path , cycle ) AS ( SELECT act01_account_cd , act01_parent_cd , 0 , ARRAY[act01_account_cd::text] , false FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND act01_account_cd = #{accountCode} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT a.act01_account_cd , a.act01_parent_cd , b.depth + 1 , array_append(b.path, a.act01_account_cd::text) , a.act01_account_cd = any(b.path) FROM act01_account_code a , downAccountTree b WHERE a.act01_parent_cd = b.act01_account_cd AND a.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(a.act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND not b.cycle )
SELECT 0 AS seq , 0 AS dtl_seq , #{startDate} AS act02_date , 0 AS act02_journal_no , null AS act02_tr_cd , '전월이월' AS act02_tr_nm , null AS act02_corp_nm , '' AS act02_note , 0 AS act03_dr_amt , 0 AS act03_cr_amt , CASE WHEN act01_drcr_type = 'D' THEN SUM(act04_dr_preday_bal_amt) ELSE SUM(act04_cr_preday_bal_amt) END AS act03_bal_amt , '' AS act03_dr_ast_nm , '' AS act03_dr_note , act04_account_cd AS act03_account_cd , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||act01_account_nm AS act03_account_nm , 0 AS act02_journal_id FROM act04_gen_ledger INNER JOIN act01_account_code ON ( act01_company_id = act04_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act04_account_cd ) WHERE act04_company_id = #{companyId} AND act04_account_cd = #{accountCode} AND act04_std_date = #{startDate} AND COALESCE(CAST(act04_ast_class_tree_id AS VARCHAR),'') LIKE #{depositIdStr} GROUP BY act01_drcr_type, act04_account_cd, act01_account_nm, act01_use_yn UNION ALL SELECT seq AS seq , dtl_seq AS dtl_seq , act02_date AS act02_date , act02_journal_no AS act02_journal_no , tr_cd AS act02_tr_cd , f_cdnm('trCode', tr_cd, act02_company_id, act02_date) AS act02_tr_nm , f_get_journal_corp_nm(act02_journal_id) AS act02_corp_nm , f_get_journal_note(act02_journal_id) AS act02_note , dr_amt AS act03_dr_amt , cr_amt AS act03_cr_amt , CASE WHEN act01_drcr_type = 'D' THEN dr_amt - cr_amt ELSE cr_amt - dr_amt END AS act03_bal_amt , f_ast_class_tree_nm(deposit_id) AS act03_dr_ast_nm , note AS act03_dr_note , account_cd AS act03_account_cd , account_nm AS act03_account_nm , act02_journal_id AS act02_journal_id FROM ( SELECT * , 1 AS seq , act03_dr_amt AS dr_amt , 0 AS cr_amt , act03_dr_ast_id AS deposit_id , act03_dr_note AS note , f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id) AS tr_cd , act03_dr_account_cd AS account_cd , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||act01_account_nm AS account_nm , act03_journal_dtl_id AS dtl_seq FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act03_journal_dtl ON act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id INNER JOIN act01_account_code ON (act01_company_id = act02_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act03_dr_account_cd) WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act03_dr_account_cd IN ( SELECT act01_account_cd FROM downAccountTree ) AND act02_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} UNION SELECT * , 2 AS seq , 0 AS dr_amt , act03_cr_amt AS cr_amt , act03_cr_ast_id AS deposit_id , act03_cr_note AS note , f_get_journal_tr_cd(act02_journal_id) AS tr_cd , act03_cr_account_cd AS account_cd , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||act01_account_nm AS account_nm , act03_journal_dtl_id AS dtl_seq FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act03_journal_dtl ON act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id INNER JOIN act01_account_code ON (act01_company_id = act02_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act03_cr_account_cd) WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act03_cr_account_cd IN ( SELECT act01_account_cd FROM downAccountTree ) AND act02_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} ) t1 WHERE COALESCE(CAST(act02_corp_id AS VARCHAR),'') LIKE #{corpIdStr} AND COALESCE(CAST(deposit_id AS VARCHAR),'') LIKE #{depositIdStr} AND COALESCE(tr_cd,'') LIKE #{trCode} ) t2 WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(act03_account_nm,act02_tr_nm,act02_note,act02_corp_nm,act03_dr_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
) x

SELECT x.act02_tr_cd AS tr_code, x.act02_tr_nm AS tr_name FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY account_cd) AS act02_journal_id , f_get_account_nm(#{companyId}, account_cd) AS act02_tr_nm , account_cd AS act02_tr_cd FROM ( SELECT f_get_fss_account_cd(#{companyId},act03_dr_account_cd) AS account_cd FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act03_journal_dtl ON act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id WHERE act02_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act03_dr_account_cd IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT f_get_fss_account_cd(#{companyId},act03_cr_account_cd) AS account_cd FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act03_journal_dtl ON act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id WHERE act02_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act03_cr_account_cd IS NOT NULL ) t
GROUP BY account_cd
) x

SELECT x.act02_tr_cd AS tr_code, x.act02_tr_nm AS tr_name FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE downAccountTree ( act01_account_cd , act01_parent_cd , depth , path , cycle ) AS ( SELECT act01_account_cd , act01_parent_cd , 0 , ARRAY[act01_account_cd::text] , false FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND act01_account_cd = #{accountCode} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT a.act01_account_cd , a.act01_parent_cd , b.depth + 1 , array_append(b.path, a.act01_account_cd::text) , a.act01_account_cd = any(b.path) FROM act01_account_code a , downAccountTree b WHERE a.act01_parent_cd = b.act01_account_cd AND a.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(a.act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND not b.cycle )
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY a.act01_account_cd) AS act02_journal_id , f_get_account_nm(#{companyId}, a.act01_account_cd) AS act02_tr_nm , a.act01_account_cd AS act02_tr_cd FROM downAccountTree a INNER JOIN act01_account_code b ON b.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND b.act01_account_cd = a.act01_account_cd WHERE act01_slip_yn = 'true'
) x
